noInherit.description: If true, the annotation is not inherited by mixins.

group.description:
Group this action belongs to from Permissions and Access Control purposes. An action can belong to more than one
group.

authzChildActions.description:
If `true`, force authorization evaluation of all the child actions invoked by the given parent action.
This annotation should only be applied on the method not the type.

authz.description:
If `always`, this action authorization must be evaluated even if the parent has the authzChildActions annotation
set to false.

local.description: If `true` action should never be remoted

title:
Annotations used by the action authorization framework.

@see Authorizer
